title: Kissinger directs the CFR study group on nuclear weapons

tellings.quote: In 1955, Kissinger was invited to direct a Council on Foreign Relations study group on nuclear war and foreign policy.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 1955 Henry Kissinger, the American statesman, was invited to direct a study group on nuclear war and foreign policy at the Council on Foreign Relations, a foreign policy organisation in New York. Michels ties the group to figures such as Robert Oppenheimer, the physicist who led the atomic bomb work, and Gordon Dean, and to Kissinger's book Nuclear Weapons and Foreign Policy. He tells it as part of asking whether Kissinger later oversaw a secret programme to recover crashed UFOs.
